tiktok.body:
What can a therapist provide that ChatGPT can’t? I have my own ideas but I want to hear from you. #therapytok #therapistsontiktok #chatgpthack #mentalhealthtiktok #therapistsontiktok
I know you've been using chat G P T. For therapy. Some of you have been using A I. For therapy or to support your mental health and then coming to see me in private practice as well. So I've been having some really interesting conversations with clients about this recently, and I'm sure there are lots of people doing the same. So I wanna broaden that conversation. I'm not gonna get into a debate about the legitimacy of having some type of mental health support free at the point of service through A I. In your pocket. I think that there is some legitimacy there, and there are also risks. And that conversation is ongoing. We're learning all the time, and we'll continue to learn for some time to come. What I'm interested in is if you're doing both. If you're seeing a therapist privately, which is a commitment financially and in terms of your. Your routine as well, at the same time as using A I. In one form or another to support your mental health. What is it that makes that justifiable? Where is it that A I. Falls down? What isn't it able to give you? What does your in person therapist provide that chat G P T. Can't offer? Let's start a conversation. Drop me a comment, and let's see where we go.
